summary: This directory houses the testing infrastructure for algorithms responsible for identifying human-authored edits and manual formatting in documentation. It validates that detection logic correctly flags complex markdown, custom formatting, and unauthorized tags.
responsibilities: Verifying the accuracy of document pattern detection algorithms
Ensuring markdown complexity is identified according to specifications
Confirming manual formatting is flagged for review
Validating that required generation tags are present and correctly structured
relationships: Test suites exercise detection logic to ensure specific document patterns are identified correctly.
Validation rules define the expected output for various document formatting checks.
designDecisions: Co-location of unit tests with detection modules to simplify maintenance
Isolation of testing logic from core analysis execution
